title: Jolt multi-POV companion
objective: Build a functional standalone multi-recording and multi-POV analysis tool consuming authentic Jolt v2.4 JSON results, with alignment, gap review, offline interface, tests, and documented limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Import Jolt v2.4 results with games, runs, breaks, points, and unread intervals
Support separately scanned recordings and independent POV tracks
Align recordings with event anchors and flag timing inconsistencies
Surface cross-POV gap inspection candidates without claiming proof
Provide offline UI, CLI, example fixtures, and passing automated tests
